description_en: Deletes blacklisted IPs from a critical event protection scenario
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-major-protection-black-ip --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5332 --rule-id 20013135 --ip-list 192.0.XX.XX,192.0.XX.XX/24 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteMajorProtectionBlackIp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the critical event protection scenario template.

This parameter requires the ID of a protection template of the critical event protection type. You can create this type of template only after purchasing the critical event protection upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
重保防护场景模板ID。

本参数需传入重保场景防护类型的防护模板ID。重保场景防护需单独升级购买后才可创建该类型模板
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP blacklist rule for critical event protection
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP blacklist to delete. Custom IP addresses or CIDR blocks are supported, including both IPv4 and IPv6. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
